Event Swatch

Motion·by @artntek·2026-08-26·inspora page·original post

What it is

Calendar drag physics: dragging an event chip in a week view lifts it with a playful tilt and stretch - the chip rotates with drag velocity, shows a floating time pill ('Wed 8:00 AM'), dims/blurs the remaining events, and rubber-bands on drop; multiple selected chips stack and fan like cards in hand.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Week grid (Wed 26 - Sat 29) with colorful event chips (yellow, green, purple, pink, orange, blue); hover lifts one chip slightly with shadow.
20-40%
Drag: grabbed chip scales ~1.05, rotates a few degrees matching cursor velocity, casts a large soft shadow; a dark time pill ('Wed 8:00 AM') floats above it; background events fade to ~50%.
40-60%
Chip travels across day columns; target slot shows a ghost outline; chip tilts opposite when direction reverses; nearby chips shift aside.
60-85%
Multi-select drag: 3-4 chips stack with slight rotational fan (-6deg..+6deg) like held cards, time pill on top; they swing as a group with lag.
85-100%
Drop: chip springs into the slot (small overshoot + squash), background restores, pill fades; single blue chip dropped alone in an empty day.

Build prompt

Build drag physics for a calendar week view. Chips: 8px radius, pastel fills with 12px titles + small icon. On pointerdown: chip lifts - scale 1.05, shadow 0 12px 32px black/18, cursor grab - over 150ms; other events dim to 50%. While dragging: chip follows the cursor with spring lag (stiffness 300, damping 22, so it trails and swings), rotation = clamp(velocityX * 0.06, -12, 12)deg updated per frame, plus slight skewY for stretch. A black time pill ('Wed 8:00 AM') floats 12px above the chip, updating as it crosses day/hour boundaries; hovered slot shows a dashed ghost of the chip's size. Multi-select: selected chips collapse into a stack at the cursor - each offset by 6px and fanned -6..+6deg, swinging as a unit with the same spring. On drop: chip eases into the slot with a 1.04 overshoot and 2% vertical squash that settles in 400ms; background restores; pill fades out.

Mechanics

trigger
pointer drag on event chip (single or multi-select)
elements
event chips, drag ghost stack, time pill, drop-target ghost, background dimming
properties
chip translate (cursor, with lag), rotation proportional to velocity x, scale 1->1.05, shadow elevation, background opacity/blur, fan angles in multi-drag
timing
lift 150ms; rotation follows velocity each frame; drop settle spring ~400ms
easing
spring lag (chips trail cursor, stiffness ~300 damping 22); drop overshoot ease
loop
no
